section_summary.extract_value: This section details the 28-item Mindful Eating Questionnaire (MEQ), outlining its five subscales which assess orientation towards food intake, awareness of sensory experiences, resistance to external cues, eating as an emotional response, and distraction while eating. It notes that the full-scale score was the focus of the present analysis, with a strong Cronbach's alpha of 0.84 in the present sample. The MEQ was also negatively correlated with BMI, as demonstrated by Framson et al. (2009).
section_summary.evidence_source: The entire section describes the MEQ, its subscales, psychometric properties, and its correlation with BMI.
